methodology.player_edges: Pearson + Spearman over aligned recent metric series for the same active player.
methodology.league_edges: Observation-weighted aggregate of active-player metric-pair edges.
methodology.outcome_dependency_edges: Phi association across unique same-event settled website POM outcomes. Used as measured ticket-dependency evidence; not causation and not a multivariate copula.
methodology.limitations: Recent-series alignment is descriptive. Cross-player teammate/event dependency requires event-aligned history and is not inferred from names or narratives.
